Results.ReviewText:
This is our second Weber grill. The first lasted 19 years with some parts being replaced.
The grill works consistently, but I’m very disappointed in the mobility.
It cannot be moved easily, ex. when cutting the grass or snow shoveling. (We use our grill throughout the winter.) The left shelf is  “ foldable/collapsible” downward and not really sturdy. 
You have to obviously lift the left  side of the grill and push/pull.
There are no firm ways of gripping the grill. The narrow plastic 
tires do not move smoothly over the surface. I’m concerned about damaging the shelf.
Having the tank exposed is very good, as it is easy to replace the tank. 
Access is  great and you can easily see the gas gauge.
Haven’t  had to clean the inside yet so can’t comment on that portion.
Results.Title: Needs better engineering for mobility.

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is easy to use and maintain. Mine reaches peak temperature between 625 and 650 (590ish with my pizza stone on the grates). The reversible grates are nice for beautiful grill marks and for keeping food from falling through. It holds the temperature well. Hooks on the sides for grilling tools are very convenient and there is gauge on the side so you how much gas is left in the tank. No more guessing!
I recommend buying the Weber cover for protection from the elements. 11 out of 10 stars
